name: Upheal
summary: AI documentation tool for therapists that turns sessions into clinical notes, with a free basic tier and optional telehealth.
description: AI documentation tool for therapists that turns sessions into clinical notes, with a free basic tier and optional telehealth.

pricing.details: Individual “Only me” plans only. Free Basic 0 €/month — AI notes via text-to-note, dictation and uploads only, individual therapy only, AI Assistant chat with a monthly usage limit, plus telehealth calling without AI. AI Notes 35 €/month, flat fee, unlimited sessions — unlimited AI notes via video, audio, dictation and uploads, individuals/couples/families, all note templates, built-in telehealth with automated notes, Treatment Plans with Golden Thread, mobile and desktop apps, AI Assistant chat with a monthly usage limit. Optional AI Assistant Pro +35 €/month for unlimited AI Assistant and session prep (start a free trial). No credit card required for the trial; official 30-day money-back guarantee. A student and non-profit discount is mentioned without a public amount.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: AI session notes for therapists, with a lasting Free Basic plan for text, dictation and uploads
AI Notes adds unlimited video and audio notes, treatment plans and built-in telehealth
Optional AI Assistant Pro add-on; official trial without a card and a 30-day money-back guarantee
Individual plans are priced on the site; group-practice and full EHR require a quote.
